findings.source: Cellar.sol:994 uint32 position = creditPositions[i]; getPositionData[position]; Uint32Array.sol:22 array[i] = array[i - 1]
findings.issue: Elements of the packed uint32[] creditPositions / debtPositions are never shown as array accesses: every read is the slot-and-mask arithmetic and every write the read-modify-write formula, and 'def storage' types them as 'array of fixed array of uint32'. Lines grow past 200 characters and the same element expression repeats in each use.
findings.rule: For a dynamic array at slot p with w-byte elements (k = 32 / w per slot), Mask(8w, 8w * (i % k), stor[i / k + keccak(p)]) >> 8w * (i % k) is storP[i], and the masked store into stor[i / k + keccak(p)] that changes only those bits is storP[i] = v; type storP as an array of w-byte values.

findings.source: MultiCall.sol:71 for (uint256 i = 0; i < data.length; i++); Uint32Array.sol:38-40 require(index < len, ...); for (uint256 i = index; i < len - 1; i++)
findings.issue: multicall's loop test is the first statement of a 'while True'. In remove, the underflow check of len - 1 is kept before the loop although 'index < len' was just required, and kept again in every iteration although t is invariant.
findings.rule: 'while True: if c: <exit>' is 'while not c:' followed by the exit. A check on loop-invariant values that holds at entry holds in every iteration; a check 'a - 1 > a' (a = 0) is false after 'require a > b' for unsigned b.
